test_title: PYST 13: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the following statements and evaluate the conclusions based on traditional syllogistic logic.

Statements: All planets are stars.

Some stars are moons.

Conclusions: I. Some planets are moons.

II. All moons being stars is a possibility.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d8c7b6d64cda74a856028c855f6794ad3ca60a007b55518c30e839870940ad1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some planets are moons → **Does not follow** (As there is no direct relation between planets and moons, so it is possible but not definitely true)

II. All moons being stars is a possibility → **Follow** (As some stars are moons, so the possibility of all moons being stars exists as it does not contradict the given statements)

∴ Here, only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1**;
